video_title: 2026-27 Blue x White Scrimmage Media Availability 🎙️ | LeBron James | 10.03.26

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on building team chemistry during training camp
quotes.excerpt: Every day is an opportunity for us to get better and better.
quotes.quote: We are just trying to build. Every day is an opportunity for us to get better and better. It is just a one percent each day mentality for us. This was another extension of our training camp and I feel like we were able to do some things that we have been working on, both offensively and defensively. We are just trying to get better, and I think today we did that.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says the Sixers are focused on a one percent better mentality each day as they work through training camp and implement new systems on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on integrating into a new team and city
quotes.excerpt: I have been able to implement some things with my voice and my command of how I play.
quotes.quote: I am still making my rounds and getting better and better each day. As far as in the building it has been very smooth in the simple fact that everybody has been super welcoming. I have been able to implement some things with my voice and my command of how I play the game and my experience of playing the game. I am still getting more and more comfortable off the floor with travel and without my family and things of that nature, so that is going to be a little bit of a challenge, but everything has been good so far. It is a great first week.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says his transition to Philadelphia has been smooth and welcoming as he adjusts to a new city and team environment.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his offensive role within the team
quotes.excerpt: I have the ability to pick up wherever the team may need.
quotes.quote: We have not given our roles yet. Coach Nurse and the coaching staff said they will do that at some point as they continue to see how we all fit together on the floor. But I have a sense of how I play the game and I know what I can do to help this team win. So, on media day I have the ability to pick up wherever the team may need.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James notes that roles have not been defined yet by Nick Nurse but he is ready to adapt to whatever the team needs to win.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Tyrese Maxey's leadership and maturity
quotes.excerpt: He definitely feels like he is much older. He definitely feels like he is not in year two.
quotes.quote: He is not quiet, and I am saying that in a good way. If there are things that happen on the floor, if there are things that he sees, if there are things that we see, we automatically figure it out right there on the floor. He is a very cerebral player and he is always looking for ways to get better on the floor. Even at his young age, he definitely feels like he is much older. He definitely feels like he is not in year two, and that is great to have. We have a lot of guys that have been around the block, a lot of guys that have a voice, and a lot of guys that want to get better every day and hold each other accountable, and that is great to see.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James praises Tyrese Maxey for his maturity and cerebral approach to the game saying he feels much older than his actual age.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the collaborative process with Nick Nurse
quotes.excerpt: I am just trying to fast track everything offensively, everything defensively, the commands, the calls, the reads.
quotes.quote: It has been great early on. I am just trying to fast track everything offensively, everything defensively, the commands, the calls, the reads and everything that they have had in place over the last few years. So I am stepping into a new system and stepping into a whole new environment. They have welcomed me with open arms and have made me get more and more comfortable every day.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James is working to fast track his understanding of the Sixers offensive and defensive schemes under Nick Nurse.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the atmosphere of the Philadelphia fan base
quotes.excerpt: It was fun to be able to play in front of some of our Philadelphia faithful.
quotes.quote: It was great. It was fun to be able to play in front of some of our Philadelphia faithful for the first time. It was a great first step in the direction we are trying to go, and it was great to hear some cheers from our fans.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says it was fun to play in front of the Philadelphia fans for the first time during the team scrimmage.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the balance of preseason play and rest
quotes.excerpt: It is important for us to do a little bit of both.
quotes.quote: It is important for us to do a little bit of both. We have four preseason games, so it would be good to get out there with some of our guys and just get a rhythm, but at the same time also not overdo it because we are putting a lot into our practices right now. We are fine-tuning what we want to do once the game comes, but I think there will be opportunities when we get out there in the preseason.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says the team is balancing preseason game reps with heavy practice loads to ensure they are ready for the regular season.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Joel Embiid's health and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: The difference between 2024 and now is he is just so much more healthier.
quotes.quote: The reps are basically just picked up from 2024 during the Olympics. We had some chemistry, we played a lot of minutes and he started a lot of games for us that summer. But the difference between 2024 and now is he is just so much more healthier. He has not missed a practice, he has been in damn near everything that we have done, and pretty much they have had to sit him out at times even when he wanted to keep going. So, obviously you see him tonight, how much he played tonight, so it has been good.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James says Joel Embiid is looking much healthier than he did in 2024 and has been a full participant in every practice so far.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the team's defensive potential and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: We could be a top 10, if not top 5 defensive team if we commit every night.
quotes.quote: I think the potential of our team defensively can be very high. If we really commit ourselves to the defensive end, we could be a top 10, if not top 5 defensive team if we commit every night. It starts at the point of attack, picking guys up from the point of position, and whoever is picking the ball up we have to have four guys behind them with eyes and ears, just communicating constantly throughout the whole possession. Even after that, if we make teams miss, a lot of teams now in the NBA are crashing three or four guys at times and we have to put bodies on bodies and we have to rebound. It does not matter how much firepower we have offensively, if we are not cleaning glass and we are not rebounding, we are never going to get out in transition. We have the length, we have the athleticism, we have the minds, we have the schemes as we are still putting them in, but if we can do that consistently, we could be really good and it is only going to help our offense.
quotes.social_post: LeBron James believes the Sixers have the potential to be a top 5 defensive team if they commit to communication and rebounding.
